literal: Having learned, those who have understood - [their] learning - will shine - fault - to be removed - word - examining - those who are capable - in [their] presence.
translation: The education of those who have learned and understood will shine in the presence of those capable of flawlessly examining words.
modern: குற்றமில்லாமல் சொற்களை ஆராய்ந்து அறியும் வல்லமை பெற்றவர்களின் அவையில்தான், கற்று அறிந்தவர்களின் கல்வி பெருமையுடன் விளங்கும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the ideal environment for true knowledge to be recognized. The phrase 'கசடறச் சொல் தெரிதல் வல்லார்' refers to experts who can flawlessly analyze and evaluate words and their profound meanings. The word 'அகத்து' means 'in the presence of' or 'in the assembly'. The poet asserts that the education of a learned person will truly shine ('விளங்கும்') and be fully appreciated only when presented before such a discerning audience.
